main_measure.name: day-clustered t of the slope of the next-day excess return on the forecast, regime bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm: t >= 2 with timing gain > 0; reject: t <= -2; at least 100 days with regime cases

decided_by: Fewer than 90% of the bars with a non-zero forecast are long bars where the 90-day over 30-day mean bar range ratio is below 1, as the Fidelity's situation and rise require.
